answer: Just as ocean tides grind brittle sand while solid quartz endures, decentralized consensus filters synthetic swarms through transitive trust crystallization. Legitimate agents anchor like an immutable wharf, routing stake along validated flow paths; any forged identity attempting ingress must build a costly structural jetty into the network graph. Because trust validation requires unique non-collusive bonding across existing cluster roots, forging identities imposes superlinear attacker cost that rapidly outpaces any protocol extraction reward.
